blocks.text: Here are the most important questions to ask before booking a limo in Anaheim — whether it’s for a wedding, prom, or corporate event:
blocks.html: Here are the most important questions to ask before booking a limo in Anaheim — whether it’s for a wedding, prom, or corporate event:

items: Is the company fully licensed and commercially insured? If the limo isn’t insured for commercial transportation, you are not legally protected during the ride. This is the number one risk with cut-rate limo ads.

What exact vehicle will arrive on the day of the event? Don’t accept “similar model” promises. Ask for the year, make, interior style, and VIN or fleet ID. Reputable companies will show you the exact vehicle, not stock photos.

Are chauffeurs trained, background-checked, and properly licensed? A limo driver is not just a driver. They manage timing, safety, guest handling, and event logistics. You want a uniformed chauffeur, not a part-time rideshare worker.
What is the final price with tax, fuel, gratuity, and fees included? A 699 quote can turn into 1100 fast if you don’t confirm the real total. Ask for an “all-in” price in writing.
What is the backup plan if the vehicle breaks down or the driver gets sick? A real limo company has a backup fleet and standby drivers. If they don’t, you’re gambling with your event.

Is alcohol allowed in the vehicle, and what are the rules? For weddings or adult parties, that’s important. For prom limo rental , the answer should always be no — and any company allowing underage drinking is risking legal trouble.
Can I see the vehicle in person or through a live video walk-through? If the company refuses, it’s usually because the car is older than advertised or poorly maintained.
